name: doba-mcp
description: Doba (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shipping, create_order, get_order,

platform_mcp_doba_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOBA_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_doba_app_key.description: appKey assigned by Doba (Retailer API > Generate Key, https://open.doba.com/apidoc/retailer/developer/key); sent as the appKey header.

platform_mcp_doba_private_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOBA_PRIVATE_KEY
platform_mcp_doba_private_key.description: Your RSA private key from the same page, as PEM: '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' + the base64 PKCS#8 key Doba shows + '-----END PRIVATE KEY-----' (newlines may be written as \n). Signs 'appKey=…&signType=rsa2&timestamp=…' with SHA256withRSA; never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_doba_platform_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOBA_PLATFORM_ID
platform_mcp_doba_platform_id.description: Doba dsPlatformId of the marketplace your orders come from (Import Order): 1 Amazon, 2 eBay, 3 Shopify, 7 BigCommerce, 8 WooCommerce, 13 Walmart, 19 TikTok Shop, 26 Etsy, 99 Others (https://open.doba.com/apidoc/retailer).

tools.name: me
tools.description: PrePay Balance Check (GET /api/pay/payManage/doba/queryPrepayBalance): businessData.data[{paymentMethodCode (7 = PrePay), remainingBalance}]. Verifies the appKey and RSA signature (requests older than 1 minute are rejected).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Query SPU List (GET /api/goods/doba/spu/list): keyword search of the Doba catalogue; `category` is a Doba catId (Query Category List). Prices are USD strings (min/max over the SPU's variants); `url` is the supplier's store page; `id` is the spuId for get_product.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Query SPU Detail (GET /api/goods/doba/spu/detail): full SPU with children[] variants, each with stocks[] per warehouse {itemNo, availableNum, sellingPrice, regionId} and shipMethods. The mapped price/sku/stock are the FIRST variant's first warehouse; `sku` is the itemNo that create_order and quote_shipping take.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Product Shipping Rate Estimate (POST /api/shipping/doba/cost/goods): `product_id` is an itemNo (get_product's `sku`), `quantity` is required. Each option's `id` (shippingMethodId) is what create_order's items take as shippingMethodId; `days` is the transit time range.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Import Order (POST /api/order/doba/importOrder) creates one UNPAID order; pay it at `pay_url` or with Doba's Order Payment API. Pass `items` in Doba form: [{itemNo (get_product's sku), quantityOrdered, shippingMethodId (from quote_shipping)}] and `shipping_address` as {name, addr1, addr2, city, provinceCode (e.g. NY), countryCode (e.g. US), zip, telephone}; it is also sent as the billing address. When nothing succeeds (address invalid, out of stock, shipping method unavailable) the call reports 'platform returned no record'. Order ids are 18-digit numbers.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get Order Detail (GET /api/order/doba/queryOrder?ordBusiId=): returns the order's batch. `id` is the order BATCH id (ordBatchId); a paid order's status (Awaiting Payment, Pending, Unshipped, In Transit, Completed), placed time and waybill come from paidOrderList, while an order still awaiting payment appears only under `unpaid_status` / raw.waitingPayOrderList.

tools.name: track
tools.description: Get Order Shipment Information (POST /api/order/doba/queryLogisTrack): one row per shipment with the waybill, carrier and logisTrackDetails[{code, desc, occurTime}]. Empty until the supplier ships.
